questions.question: Find the value of sec² 18circ - cot² 72circ + sin² 30circ + {cosec}² 60circ - {cosec}² 18circ + tan² 72circ .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use complementary angle relations: cot 72° = tan 18° and tan 72° = cot 18°.

Group terms: (sec² 18° − tan² 18°) + (cot² 18° − cosec² 18°) + sin² 30° + cosec² 60°.

Apply identities: (1) + (−1) + sin² 30° + cosec² 60°.

Value = 0 + (1/2)² + (2/√3)² = 1/4 + 4/3.

Total = (3 + 16) / 12 = 19/12.

**∴ The correct answer is 19/12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: sec² 18° − cot² 72° + sin² 30° + cosec² 60° − cosec² 18° + tan² 72°

Formula Used: cot(90° − θ) = tan θ | tan(90° − θ) = cot θ | sec² θ − tan² θ = 1 | cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1

⇒ sec² 18° − tan²(90° − 72°) + sin² 30° + cosec² 60° − cosec² 18° + cot²(90° − 72°)

⇒ sec² 18° − tan² 18° + sin² 30° + cosec² 60° − cosec² 18° + cot² 18°

⇒ (sec² 18° − tan² 18°) + sin² 30° + cosec² 60° − (cosec² 18° − cot² 18°)

⇒ 1 + (1/2)² + (2/√3)² − 1

⇒ 1/4 + 4/3

⇒ (3 + 16) / 12

⇒ 19/12

**∴ The correct answer is 19/12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angle Identities

For angles adding to 90°, ratios convert: sin ↔ cos, tan ↔ cot, sec ↔ cosec.

Pythagorean Identities

The three basic identities are sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, and cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1.

Reciprocal Trigonometric Values

Standard values for common angles: sin 30° = 1/2, cos 30° = √3/2, tan 30° = 1/√3, and their reciprocals.

questions.question:
What is the mode of the following data?

85, 73, 89, 82, 67, 61, 78, 69, 86, 68, 64, 76, 64, 85, 68, 85, 68, 81, 68, 72, 64, 72, 76, 84, 88
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Mode is the observation that occurs most frequently in the data set.

Count occurrences: 68 appears 4 times.

Count occurrences: 85 appears 3 times.

Count occurrences: 64 appears 3 times.

Other values (72, 76, etc.) occur only 1 or 2 times.

**∴ The correct answer is 68.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given data:** 85, 73, 89, 82, 67, 61, 78, 69, 86, 68, 64, 76, 64, 85, 68, 85, 68, 81, 68, 72, 64, 72, 76, 84, 88

**Formula Used:** Mode = Value with the maximum frequency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55e6c8fdf89348353c79baf3f0a60a3bc5ac4b98400b33a61fb0de0d2e897aaf.png] 

⇒ Frequency of 61 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 64 = 3

⇒ Frequency of 68 = 4

⇒ Frequency of 72 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 76 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 85 = 3

⇒ All other values (67, 69, 73, 78, 81, 82, 84, 86, 88, 89) occur 1 time each.

⇒ The value 68 occurs the most number of times (4).

**∴ The correct answer is 68.**

**__Additional Information__**

Empirical Formula

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode is: Mode = (3 × Median) − (2 × Mean).

Bimodal and Multimodal Data

If two or more values have the same maximum frequency, the data set is said to be bimodal (two modes) or multimodal (multiple modes).

Mean and Median

Mean is the average calculated by Σx ÷ n. Median is the middle value of the data set when arranged in ascending or descending order.</p

questions.question: The average of the first 16 odd natural numbers, is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The average of the first 'n' odd natural numbers is always equal to 'n'.

Here, the total number of terms (n) = 16.

Average = 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: n = 16 odd natural numbers.

Formula: Average of an Arithmetic Progression (A.P.) = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05fae30ecece86036591ed82adf705e802703b699cb2b12edd6dc99e39cc826c.png] 

⇒ First odd natural number (a) = 1

⇒ 16th odd natural number (l) = a + (n − 1) × d = 1 + (16 − 1) × 2 = 31

⇒ Total Sum = (n ÷ 2) × (a + l) = (16 ÷ 2) × (1 + 31) = 8 × 32 = 256

⇒ Average = Total Sum ÷ n = 256 ÷ 16 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average of Even Numbers

The average of the first n even natural numbers is always (n + 1).

Average of Consecutive Natural Numbers

The average of the first n natural numbers is given by (n + 1) ÷ 2.

Sum of First n Odd Numbers

The sum of the first n odd natural numbers is n².

Average of Squares

The average of squares of first n natural numbers is [(n + 1)(2n + 1)] ÷ 6.</p

questions.question: In an election held between two candidates, 75% voters cast their votes. Out of them 2% votes were declared invalid. One candidate got 9261 votes which was 75% of valid votes. In this election what was the total number of registered voters ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total number of registered voters be X.

Apply the successive percentage factors: X × (Cast%) × (Valid%) × (Candidate Share%) = 9261

⇒ X × 75/100 × 98/100 × 75/100 = 9261

⇒ X × 3/4 × 49/50 × 3/4 = 9261

⇒ X × 441/800 = 9261 ⇒ X = 21 × 800 = 16800

**∴ The correct answer is 16,800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Votes cast = 75% of Registered Voters

Invalid votes = 2% of cast votes ⇒ Valid votes = 98% of cast votes

Candidate share = 75% of valid votes = 9261

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7baae72851938eef43acc71385ec573e7a53f4fb28ee29ee9bee1d56656cc042.png] 

**Formula:** Registered Voters = (Winner Votes × 100 × 100 × 100) ÷ (Cast% × Valid% × Share%)

⇒ Total Voters = (9261 × 100 × 100 × 100) ÷ (75 × 98 × 75)

⇒ Total Voters = (9261 × 4 × 50 × 4) ÷ (3 × 49 × 3)

⇒ Total Voters = (9261 × 800) ÷ (9 × 49)

⇒ Total Voters = (9261 × 800) ÷ 441

⇒ Total Voters = 21 × 800

⇒ Total Voters = 16800

**∴ The correct answer is 16,800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Vote Distribution

Total Registered = Cast + Not Cast; Cast = Valid + Invalid. Calculations are always performed on Valid votes unless specified otherwise.

Successive Percentage Method

When multiple changes occur on a base value, the final value = Initial × (a/100) × (b/100) × (c/100). This is the fastest way to solve election and population problems.

Valid vs Invalid Ratio

If p% are invalid, then valid votes = Total Cast × (100 − p)/100.</p

questions.question: The difference between a single discount of 46% and two successive discounts of 30% and 20% on the marked price of an article is ₹256. Find the marked price of the article (in ₹).
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Effective successive discount of 30% and 20% = 30 + 20 − (30 × 20)/100 = 44%

Difference in discount percentages = 46% − 44% = 2%

Given that 2% of the Marked Price = ₹256

Marked Price (100%) = (256 ÷ 2) × 100 = ₹12,800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,800.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Single discount = 46%

Successive discounts = 30% and 20%

Difference in discount amount = ₹256

**Formula Used:**

Equivalent discount for two successive discounts a% and b% = (a + b − ab/100)%

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (100 − Discount%)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05ca4cb99c27b8d8e980801a8a62f19c3555a4e0dece6acaf01f93a47deadc6e.png] 

⇒ Effective discount of 30% and 20% = (30 + 20 − (30 × 20)/100)%

⇒ Effective discount = 50 − 6 = 44%

⇒ Difference between first and second discount scenarios = 46% − 44% = 2%

⇒ According to the problem: 2% of Marked Price = 256

⇒ Marked Price = (256 × 100) ÷ 2

⇒ Marked Price = 128 × 100 = 12,800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,800.**

**__Additional Information__**

Single Equivalent Discount Formula

For two successive discounts of x% and y%, the single equivalent discount is (x + y − xy/100)%.

Relationship between MP and SP

The Selling Price after a discount d% on Marked Price is calculated as: SP = MP × (100 − d)/100.

Successive Discounts (Three or more)

For three successive discounts d₁, d₂, and d₃, the final SP is MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × (1 − d₃/100).

questions.question: A girl goes to school at a speed of 10 km/hr. She comes back with a speed of 40 km/hr. Find her average speed for the whole journey.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance is the same for both journeys, use the Harmonic Mean formula:

Average Speed = (2 × s₁ × s₂) / (s₁ + s₂)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 10 × 40) / (10 + 40)

⇒ Average Speed = 800 / 50 = 16 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed while going (s₁) = 10 km/hr

Speed while returning (s₂) = 40 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f9a7aa8de508f4c0ca3a3f3cae2e9be386a8f04c0e36f106d6c9ac3b437cf42.png] 

Let the distance between home and school be the LCM of 10 and 40, which is 40 km.

⇒ Distance (D) = 40 km

⇒ Time taken while going (t₁) = Distance / s₁ = 40 / 10 = 4 hours

⇒ Time taken while returning (t₂) = Distance / s₂ = 40 / 40 = 1 hour

⇒ Total Distance = 40 + 40 = 80 km

⇒ Total Time = 4 + 1 = 5 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 80 / 5 = 16 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 16 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for different distances

When distances are not equal, use the general formula: Average Speed = (d₁ + d₂ + ... + dₙ) / (t₁ + t₂ + ... + tₙ).

Three equal distances

If a journey is divided into three equal parts covered at speeds x, y, and z, the average speed is (3xyz) / (xy + yz + zx).

Speed Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

questions.question: ₹13,525 is divided among A, B, and C in such a way that if ₹29, ₹70, and ₹28 be deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 19 : 6 : 8. Find the difference between the B’s and C’s original shares.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total deduction = 29 + 70 + 28 = ₹127

Remaining amount = 13,525 − 127 = ₹13,398

Sum of ratio parts = 19 + 6 + 8 = 33 units

1 unit = 13398 ÷ 33 = 406

Difference (B & C) = |(8 × 406 + 28) − (6 × 406 + 70)| = 812 − 42 = 770

**∴ The correct answer is ₹770.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = ₹13,525

Deductions from A, B, C = ₹29, ₹70, ₹28

Ratio after deduction = 19 : 6 : 8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27111d49b668c7ab21e7d35f41e2324f4ce74404190bf4bfc91c2efd2975a048.png] 

Sum of remaining amount = 13,525 − (29 + 70 + 28)

⇒ 13,525 − 127 = 13,398

⇒ Let the shares after deduction be 19x, 6x, and 8x.

⇒ 19x + 6x + 8x = 13,398

⇒ 33x = 13,398

⇒ x = 13,398 ÷ 33 = 406

⇒ B's original share = 6x + 70 = 6 × 406 + 70 = 2,436 + 70 = 2,506

⇒ C's original share = 8x + 28 = 8 × 406 + 28 = 3,248 + 28 = 3,276

⇒ Difference = 3,276 − 2,506 = 770

**∴ The correct answer is ₹770.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion Basics

A ratio a : b indicates that for every 'a' units of the first quantity, there are 'b' units of the second. To find individual values, divide the total sum by the sum of ratio parts (a + b) to find the value of one unit.

Handling Deductions in Ratios

When fixed amounts are deducted from shares to reach a specific ratio, subtract the total deduction from the grand total before applying the ratio distribution formula.

Unitary Method in Ratios

Value of 'n' parts = (Total Value ÷ Total Ratio Parts) × n. This is the fastest way to calculate individual components in banking exams.

questions.question:
A shopkeeper bought 10 kg wheat at ₹ 20 per kg and 15 kg wheat at ₹ 30 per kg and mixed them.
At what price per kg should he sell the mixed variety of wheat to earn 10% profit ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of quantities = 10 : 15 = 2 : 3

Weighted Average CP = [(2 × 20) + (3 × 30)] ÷ (2 + 3)

⇒ 130 ÷ 5 = ₹ 26 per kg

Selling price for 10% profit = 26 × 110% = ₹ 28.60

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 28.60.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quantity₁ = 10 kg, Price₁ = ₹ 20/kg

Quantity₂ = 15 kg, Price₂ = ₹ 30/kg

Desired Profit = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Total CP = (Q₁ × P₁) + (Q₂ × P₂)

Selling Price (SP) = CPₐvg × (100 + Profit%)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7a6ebb46da6582c08df3872b84b90d5e932a4584172b1326f296c41cfcd477b.png] 

⇒ Total cost of 10 kg wheat = 10 × 20 = ₹ 200

⇒ Total cost of 15 kg wheat = 15 × 30 = ₹ 450

⇒ Total CP of 25 kg mixture = 200 + 450 = ₹ 650

⇒ Cost price per kg of mixture = 650 ÷ 25 = ₹ 26

⇒ To earn 10% profit, SP = 26 + (10% of 26)

⇒ SP = 26 + 2.60 = ₹ 28.60

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 28.60.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

The average price of a mixture is calculated as (n₁c₁ + n₂c₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is quantity and c is cost.

Profit Percentage

Profit is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP). Selling Price = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100.

Alligation Rule

It is a shorter way to find the ratio in which two ingredients are mixed: (Higher Price − Mean Price) : (Mean Price − Lower Price).

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 15 minutes and Pipe B can fill it in 35 minutes, while Pipe C can empty the full cistern in 1 hour. If all the pipes are turned on at the same time, in how much time (in minutes) will the cistern be full?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity = LCM of (15, 35, 60) = 420 units.

Efficiencies: A = 420/15 = 28 | B = 420/35 = 12 | C = −420/60 = −7 (Outlet).

Combined Efficiency (A + B + C) = 28 + 12 − 7 = 33 units/min.

Required time = 420 ÷ 33 = 140/11 minutes.

Time = 12⁸/₁₁ minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 12⁸/₁₁ minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Time for Pipe A = 15 mins

Time for Pipe B = 35 mins

Time for Pipe C (Emptying) = 1 hour = 60 mins

Formula used: Net Efficiency = Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B − Efficiency of C

Combined efficiency of A + B + C = 28 + 12 − 7 = 33 units/min

⇒ Total capacity = LCM(15, 35, 60) = 420 units

⇒ Time to fill cistern = Capacity ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time = 420 ÷ 33

⇒ Time = 140 ÷ 11

⇒ Time = 12⁸/₁₁ minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 12⁸/₁₁ minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inlet and Outlet Pipes

Work done by an inlet pipe is always taken as positive, whereas work done by an outlet pipe is taken as negative.

Net Work Formula

If pipe A fills in x hours and pipe B empties in y hours (y > x), then the part filled in 1 hour is (1/x − 1/y).

Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete the work (Efficiency ∝ 1/Time).</p

questions.question: If 66% of the first number is equal to three-fifths of the second number, what is the ratio of the first number to the second number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert both values to a common form (percentage).

66% of 1st Number = (3/5 × 100)% of 2ⁿd Number

66% of 1st Number = 60% of 2ⁿd Number

Ratio (1st : 2ⁿd) = Inverse of their coefficients = 60 : 66

Simplifying by dividing by 6 ⇒ 10 : 11

**∴ The correct answer is 10 : 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of first number = 66%

Fraction of second number = 3/5

**Formula:**

Value = (Percentage/100) × Number | Ratio A : B = A/B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cece5c0902999727f7d3fa39a8f0b278da678aac69b68ac6f06c91c356f59594.png] 

Let the first number be x and the second number be y.

⇒ 66% of x = (3/5) of y

⇒ (66/100) × x = (3/5) × y

⇒ (33/50) × x = (3/5) × y

⇒ x/y = (3/5) ÷ (33/50)

⇒ x/y = (3/5) × (50/33)

⇒ x/y = (1 × 10) / (1 × 11)

⇒ x/y = 10/11

**∴ The correct answer is 10 : 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert x% to a fraction, divide by 100: x/100. Conversely, multiply a fraction by 100 to get the percentage.

Ratio Balancing Rule

If m × A = n × B, then the ratio A : B is equal to n : m. This is known as the inverse coefficient rule.

Simplifying Ratios

A ratio a : b can be simplified by dividing both terms by their Highest Common Factor (HCF) to reach the simplest form.</p

questions.question: The ratio of incomes of two persons is 8:5 and the ratio of their expenditure is 2:1. If each of them manages to save ₹160 per month, find the difference of their monthly income.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income ratio = 8 : 5 and Expenditure ratio = 2 : 1

Savings are same (₹160), use cross-product method:

| (8 × 1) − (5 × 2) | units = | 160 × (1 − 2) |

⇒ | 8 − 10 | units = | −160 | ⇒ 2 units = 160

⇒ 1 unit = 80

Difference in income = (8 − 5) = 3 units = 3 × 80 = ₹240

**∴ The correct answer is ₹240.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Ratio of Incomes = 8 : 5, Ratio of Expenditures = 2 : 1, Individual Savings = ₹160.

Formula: Income − Expenditure = Savings

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55b4ef4a6ccce424c9f010589935ca1f6304f1dd8918a7333e3180879253204b.png] 

Let the incomes be 8x and 5x.

Let the expenditures be 2y and y.

⇒ 8x − 2y = 160 ... (i)

⇒ 5x − y = 160 ⇒ y = 5x − 160 ... (ii)

Substituting the value of y from equation (ii) into equation (i):

⇒ 8x − 2(5x − 160) = 160

⇒ 8x − 10x + 320 = 160

⇒ −2x = 160 − 320

⇒ −2x = −160 ⇒ x = 80

⇒ Monthly income of first person = 8 × 80 = ₹640

⇒ Monthly income of second person = 5 × 80 = ₹400

⇒ Difference = 640 − 400 = ₹240

**∴ The correct answer is ₹240.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure and Savings

The basic relationship is Income = Expenditure + Savings. If savings are equal for both parties, the difference in income units is proportional to the difference in expenditure units after scaling.

Ratio Balancing

To solve without algebra, multiply the expenditure ratio by a factor so that the difference (Income Unit − Expenditure Unit) is equal for both persons.

Proportion Rule

If A:B is the ratio of two quantities, the difference is expressed as |A − B| units. To find the real value, multiply this unit difference by the value of 1 unit.

questions.question: Find the volume of a cuboid whose length, breadth and height are in the ratio 4 : 3 : 2 and total surface area is 832 {cm}² .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) ratio units = 2 × (4×3 + 3×2 + 2×4) = 52 units²

Scaling factor squared (x²) = Total Area ÷ Ratio units = 832 ÷ 52 = 16

Linear scaling factor (x) = √16 = 4 cm

Volume ratio units = 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 units³

Actual Volume = 24 × (x)³ = 24 × 4³ = 24 × 64 = 1536 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1536 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of length (L) : breadth (B) : height (H) = 4 : 3 : 2

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 832 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of cuboid = 2(LB + BH + HL)

Volume of cuboid = L × B × H

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfbae3992048eb5c0eeda1f36d1ebcc94e2f6d7acb585a44bcf1a5d5da24178e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Length (L) = 4x, Breadth (B) = 3x, and Height (H) = 2x

⇒ 2[(4x × 3x) + (3x × 2x) + (2x × 4x)] = 832

⇒ 2[12x² + 6x² + 8x²] = 832

⇒ 2[26x²] = 832

⇒ 52x² = 832

⇒ x² = 832 ÷ 52 = 16

⇒ x = √16 = 4

⇒ L = 4 × 4 = 16 cm

⇒ B = 3 × 4 = 12 cm

⇒ H = 2 × 4 = 8 cm

⇒ Volume = 16 × 12 × 8

⇒ Volume = 1536 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1536 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The surface area of the four vertical walls of the cuboid is 2h(l + b).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest rod that can fit in a cuboid is √(l² + b² + h²).

Properties of a Cube

A cube is a special cuboid where l = b = h = a. TSA = 6a² and Volume = a³.</p

questions.question: Nine years ago, Asha was thrice as old as Bhawna. Seven years from now, Asha will be twice as old as Bhawna. Find the present age of Bhawna.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio (A : B) 9 yrs ago = 3 : 1 (Difference = 2)

Ratio (A : B) 7 yrs hence = 2 : 1 × 2 = 4 : 2 (Difference = 2)

Total time gap = 9 + 7 = 16 years

Unit difference in B’s ratio = 2 − 1 = 1 unit

⇒ 1 unit = 16 years

Bhawna’s age 9 yrs ago = 1 unit = 16 years

Bhawna’s present age = 16 + 9 = 25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 25 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 9 years ago Asha = 3 × Bhawna. 7 years hence Asha = 2 × Bhawna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c60dcdaba912d47728ee4e53113b62ebfe304b662ed53fc6981310a64c174df.png] 

Let the present age of Bhawna be B and Asha be A.

⇒ (A − 9) = 3(B − 9)

⇒ A − 9 = 3B − 27

⇒ A = 3B − 18 — (i)

⇒ (A + 7) = 2(B + 7)

⇒ A + 7 = 2B + 14

⇒ A = 2B + 7 — (ii)

Equating (i) and (ii):

⇒ 3B − 18 = 2B + 7

⇒ 3B − 2B = 7 + 18

⇒ B = 25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 25 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals always remains the same, regardless of how many years pass.

Ratio Balancing

In age problems involving ratios, multiply the ratios by the difference of the other ratio to equalize the unit gaps between years.

Average Age Property

If the average age of a group of n people is X, then after k years, the new average age will be X + k.</p

questions.question: There are 156 boy students and 143 girl students in a school. The principal wants to divide them in sections, such that a section can have only boys or only girls. If all sections should have the same number of students, and the principal wants to have as fewer sections as possible, how many sections would be there in the school?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To minimize sections, maximize students per section using HCF.

Students per section = HCF(156, 143)

156 = 13 × 12 and 143 = 13 × 11 ⇒ HCF = 13

Number of sections = (156 ÷ 13) + (143 ÷ 13)

Number of sections = 12 + 11 = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of boy students = 156

Number of girl students = 143

Condition: Each section must have same number of students and contain only boys or girls.

**Formula Used:**

To have the fewest sections, the size of each section must be the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of the number of boys and girls.

Total Sections = (Number of Boys ÷ HCF) + (Number of Girls ÷ HCF)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b7e7fcdaaa7e66b43de2d43f2c30f9e5b90390855a9113835e9f4f661d6b629.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factors of 156 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 13

⇒ Prime factors of 143 = 11 × 13

⇒ Common factor (HCF) = 13

⇒ Number of boy sections = 156 ÷ 13 = 12

⇒ Number of girl sections = 143 ÷ 13 = 11

⇒ Total number of sections = 12 + 11

⇒ Total sections = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

It is the largest positive integer that divides each of the integers without a remainder. It is used to find the maximum size for equal grouping.

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

LCM is the smallest positive integer that is divisible by both a and b. It is used for problems involving cycles or meeting times.

HCF × LCM Property

For two numbers a and b, Product of numbers = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).</p

Difference of Squares

Common Cubes

questions.question: Find the single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 28% and 16%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Single equivalent discount formula for two successive discounts a% and b%:

Equivalent Discount = [a + b − (a × b / 100)]%

⇒ Equivalent Discount = [28 + 16 − (28 × 16 / 100)]%

⇒ Equivalent Discount = [44 − 4.48]% = 39.52%

**∴ The correct answer is 39.52%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: First discount (d₁) = 28%, Second discount (d₂) = 16%

Formula: Final Price = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b630afb4a5aac233638567f9064d1a42694cc88fac6d15353afc2f7a4cb7ae14.png] 

⇒ Let the Marked Price (MP) be 100 units.

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 100 − (28% of 100) = 100 − 28 = 72 units.

⇒ Price after 2ⁿd discount = 72 − (16% of 72)

⇒ Second discount amount = (16 × 72) / 100 = 1152 / 100 = 11.52 units.

⇒ Final Selling Price (SP) = 72 − 11.52 = 60.48 units.

⇒ Total Discount = MP − SP = 100 − 60.48 = 39.52 units.

⇒ Single Equivalent Discount Percentage = (39.52 / 100) × 100 = 39.52%

**∴ The correct answer is 39.52%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Three Successive Discounts

If three discounts a%, b%, and c% are given, the equivalent discount is 1 − [(1 − a/100)(1 − b/100)(1 − c/100)] × 100.

Successive Percentage Increase

For two successive increases of x% and y%, the effective increase is [x + y + (xy/100)]%.

Relation between SP, MP and Discount

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (100 − Discount%)/100.</p

questions.question: A sum of ₹15,000 is lent at the rate of 15% per annum compound interest, compounded annually for two years. What is the interest received (in ₹) after two years?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Effective Rate of interest for 2 years = R + R + (R × R)/100

Effective Rate = 15 + 15 + (15 × 15)/100 = 32.25%

Total Interest = 15000 × 32.25%

Total Interest = 150 × 32.25 = 4837.50

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,837.50.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹15,000

Rate (R) = 15% per annum

Time (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

Compound Interest (CI) = A − P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9152664a162eb8d133b828f516dd79c561674a1325401d20aca94ee4e65123bc.png] 

⇒ Amount (A) = 15000 × (1 + 15/100)²

⇒ A = 15000 × (1.15)²

⇒ A = 15000 × 1.3225

⇒ A = 19837.50

⇒ Interest = 19837.50 − 15000

⇒ Interest = 4837.50

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,837.50.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

CI = P[(1 + R/100)ⁿ − 1], where P is principal, R is rate, and n is time in years.

Difference between CI and SI

The difference for 2 years is given by CI − SI = P(R/100)².

Half-Yearly Compounding

If interest is compounded half-yearly, the rate becomes R/2 and the time becomes 2n.

questions.question:
Evaluate the given expression.

35 - [25 - {31 - (21 - 11 + 9)}]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve following BODMAS order from inner to outer brackets:

Parentheses: (21 − 11 + 9) = 19

Curly Braces: {31 − 19} = 12

Square Brackets: [25 − 12] = 13

Final calculation: 35 − 13 = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 35 − [25 − {31 − (21 − 11 + 9)}]

Formula used: BODMAS Rule (Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 35 − [25 − {31 − (10 + 9)}]

⇒ 35 − [25 − {31 − 19}]

⇒ 35 − [25 − 12]

⇒ 35 − 13

⇒ 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS / VBODMAS Rule

It defines the order of operations: V (Vinculum/Bar), B (Brackets), O (Of), D (Division), M (Multiplication), A (Addition), S (Subtraction).

Types of Brackets

Brackets must be opened in this specific order: Vinculum (line), then Circular brackets (), then Curly braces {}, and finally Square brackets [].

Addition and Subtraction Priority

When only addition and subtraction remain, operations are performed strictly from left to right to ensure accuracy.</p

questions.question: Successive discounts of 40% and 15% are equivalent to a single discount of ________.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Discount Formula for two successive discounts a% and b%:

Net Discount = [a + b − (a × b / 100)]%

Here, a = 40 and b = 15

Net Discount = [40 + 15 − (40 × 15 / 100)]% = [55 − 6]% = 49%

**∴ The correct answer is 49%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

First discount (d₁) = 40%

Second discount (d₂) = 15%

Formula: Final Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd59ab0241f6614371a984aa9cf919ead5e02b1e94dbc624ae0dc88504d6233e.png] 

Let the Marked Price (MP) be 100 units.

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 100 − (40% of 100)

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 100 − 40 = 60 units

⇒ Price after 2nd discount = 60 − (15% of 60)

⇒ Price after 2nd discount = 60 − (15/100 × 60)

⇒ Price after 2nd discount = 60 − 9 = 51 units

⇒ Single Equivalent Discount = (MP − Final Price) / MP × 100

⇒ Single Equivalent Discount = (100 − 51) / 100 × 100

⇒ Single Equivalent Discount = 49%

**∴ The correct answer is 49%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Three Successive Discounts

For three successive discounts a%, b%, and c%, calculate the net of a and b first, then use that result with c using the formula x + y − xy/100.

Marked Price and Selling Price Relation

Selling Price = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100. This is useful for large number calculations.

Successive Percentage Increase

If values increase successively, use the formula: a + b + (ab / 100)% for the overall percentage change.</p

questions.question: In a quadrilateral ABCD, angle A = 36^circ and angle B = 93^circ . The bisectors of angle C and angle D meet at O. What is the measure of angle DOC ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Angle between bisectors of ∠C and ∠D in a quadrilateral = (∠A + ∠B) ÷ 2

Given: ∠A = 36° and ∠B = 93°

∠DOC = (36° + 93°) ÷ 2

∠DOC = 129° ÷ 2 = 64.5°

**∴ The correct answer is 64.5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: ∠A = 36°, ∠B = 93°, CO and DO are bisectors of ∠C and ∠D.

Formula: Sum of angles in a quadrilateral = 360° | Sum of angles in a triangle = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a96a7e9a7ef13da55e1b9aaf0d42bba9aeb9c1ca739d42364f1418dd5b0cf72.png] 

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C + ∠D = 360°

⇒ 36° + 93° + ∠C + ∠D = 360°

⇒ 129° + ∠C + ∠D = 360°

⇒ ∠C + ∠D = 360° − 129° = 231°

⇒ Divide by 2: (∠C + ∠D) / 2 = 231° / 2 = 115.5°

⇒ In ΔDOC, ∠DOC + ∠OCD + ∠ODC = 180°

⇒ ∠DOC + (∠C / 2) + (∠D / 2) = 180°

⇒ ∠DOC + 115.5° = 180°

⇒ ∠DOC = 180° − 115.5° = 64.5°

**∴ The correct answer is 64.5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

For any n-sided polygon, the sum of interior angles is (n − 2) × 180°.

Angle Bisector Relation

In a quadrilateral, the angle between the internal bisectors of two opposite angles is half the difference of the other two angles.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

In a cyclic quadrilateral, opposite angles are supplementary, meaning their sum is always 180°.</p

questions.question: The number of two-digit numbers divisible by 6 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Smallest two-digit multiple of 6 = 12

Largest two-digit multiple of 6 = 96

Total numbers (n) = [(Last Term − First Term) ÷ Common Difference] + 1

Total numbers (n) = [(96 − 12) ÷ 6] + 1

n = [84 ÷ 6] + 1 = 14 + 1 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Two-digit numbers range from 10 to 99. We need to find multiples of 6 in this range.

Formula used: nth term of an Arithmetic Progression (A.P.), aₙ = a + (n − 1)d

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c69b9e1d4d3b2b2e7d18e751c5531790d6be0ea51adca50d8f2f9c1b35056e5e.png] 

⇒ First term (a) = 12

⇒ Last term (aₙ) = 96

⇒ Common difference (d) = 6

⇒ 96 = 12 + (n − 1) × 6

⇒ 96 − 12 = (n − 1) × 6

⇒ 84 = (n − 1) × 6

⇒ n − 1 = 84 ÷ 6

⇒ n − 1 = 14

⇒ n = 14 + 1 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Progression (AP)

A sequence of numbers where the difference between consecutive terms is constant, denoted as 'd'.

Sum of n terms of AP

The sum Sₙ can be calculated using Sₙ = (n ÷ 2)[2a + (n − 1)d] or Sₙ = (n ÷ 2)[a + l].

Divisibility Rule of 6

A number is divisible by 6 if it is divisible by both 2 (ends in even digit) and 3 (sum of digits is divisible by 3).</p

questions.question: Rishi can do a piece of work in 11 days. Shan is 10% more efficient than Rishi. The number of days taken by Shan to do the same piece of work is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency ratio of Rishi : Shan = 100 : 110 = 10 : 11.

Since Efficiency is inversely proportional to Time, Time ratio = 11 : 10.

Rishi takes 11 units of time, which is given as 11 days.

∴ 1 unit = 1 day.

Shan takes 10 units of time = 10 × 1 = 10 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Rishi completes work in 11 days. Shan is 10% more efficient than Rishi.

Let efficiency of Rishi = 10 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of Shan = 10 + (10% of 10) = 11 units/day.

⇒ Total Work = Efficiency of Rishi × Time taken by Rishi

⇒ Total Work = 10 × 11 = 110 units.

questions.question: A man loses 20% of his money. He then spends 25% of what remains. If he is left with ₹525, what was his original amount?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total remaining fraction = (1 − 1/5) × (1 − 1/4) = 4/5 × 3/4 = 3/5

Here, 3 units represent the remaining amount ₹525.

1 unit = 525 ÷ 3 = 175

Original amount (5 units) = 175 × 5 = ₹875

**∴ The correct answer is ₹875.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Loss percentage = 20%

Expenditure from remainder = 25%

Final amount left = ₹525

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (100 − R₁)/100 × (100 − R₂)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b8c55559993e05d6c2eab4c1f644afe904f0c1636b547259a46098e5fe2be86.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the original amount be ₹ x.

⇒ Amount left after 20% loss = x − (20/100) × x = 0.8x

⇒ Amount spent from remainder = 25% of 0.8x = (25/100) × 0.8x = 0.2x

⇒ Final amount left = 0.8x − 0.2x = 0.6x

⇒ 0.6x = 525

⇒ x = 525 ÷ 0.6

⇒ x = 5250 ÷ 6

⇒ x = 875

**∴ The correct answer is ₹875.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by a% and then b%, the net effective change is given by (a + b + ab/100)%.

Successive Discounts

Two successive discounts of x% and y% are equivalent to a single discount of (x + y − xy/100)%.

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To simplify calculations, use 20% = 1/5 and 25% = 1/4 to find the multipliers directly.

questions.question: If the ratio of the the speeds of three cars is 2:3:5, then the ratio of the time taken by these three cars to travel the same distance is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, the ratio of time is the inverse of the ratio of speed.

Ratio of speeds = 2 : 3 : 5

Ratio of times = (3 × 5) : (2 × 5) : (2 × 3)

Ratio of times = 15 : 10 : 6

**∴ The correct answer is 15 : 10 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of speeds of three cars (S₁ : S₂ : S₃) = 2 : 3 : 5

Distance (D) = Constant for all three cars

**Formula Used:**

Time (T) = Distance (D) ÷ Speed (S)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8d8fd523aa0a6654aca38116372c157bcfb31476b0732040aa06556175b1df7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ T₁ : T₂ : T₃ = (D/S₁) : (D/S₂) : (D/S₃)

⇒ T₁ : T₂ : T₃ = (1/2) : (1/3) : (1/5)

⇒ To simplify, multiply each term by the LCM of 2, 3, and 5.

⇒ LCM(2, 3, 5) = 30

⇒ T₁ : T₂ : T₃ = (1/2 × 30) : (1/3 × 30) : (1/5 × 30)

⇒ T₁ : T₂ : T₃ = 15 : 10 : 6

**∴ The correct answer is 15 : 10 : 6.**

Inverse Proportionality

When the product of two variables is constant (Distance = Speed × Time), the variables are inversely proportional; as speed increases, time decreases.

Average Speed

For two equal distances covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
